items.exampleEn: The teacher wants more interaction in class.
items.exampleZh: 老師希望課堂上有更多互動。

items.exampleEn: Wrap the fish in paper before you put it in the freezer.
items.exampleZh: 把魚放進冷凍庫前，先用紙包起來。

items.exampleEn: My observations show that birds come back every spring.
items.exampleZh: 我的觀察顯示鳥每年春天都會回來。

items.exampleEn: Be careful of the gap between the train and the platform.
items.exampleZh: 請注意列車與月台之間的缺口。

items.exampleEn: Don't drag your feet when you walk.
The team started badly but recovered and won the game.
items.exampleZh: 那支球隊開局不好，但後來恢復狀態贏了比賽。

items.exampleEn: Small settlements grew into big cities over time.
items.exampleZh: 隨著時間過去，小聚落發展成了大城市。

items.sentenceEn: The gap between the two teams is small.

items.audioEn: If you need assistance with your bags, please ask the staff at the front desk.
items.audioZh: 如果你需要幫忙提行李，請洽詢櫃台的工作人員。
items.questionZh: 需要幫忙提行李時該怎麼做？
options: Ask the staff at the front desk.

items.sentenceEn: She wrapped a warm scarf around her neck.
items.sentenceZh: 她把溫暖的圍巾圍在脖子上。

items.sentenceEn: The company offers free assistance to new customers.
items.sentenceZh: 這家公司為新顧客提供免費協助。

items.stemEn: There is a small ____ between the door and the floor, so cold air gets in.
items.stemZh: 門和地板之間有一個小縫，所以冷空氣會跑進來。

items.stemEn: The tired child ____ his school bag along the ground behind him.
items.stemZh: 那個累壞的孩子把書包拖在身後的地上。

items.passageEn: Last winter, my grandmother hurt her arm, but she has fully recovered now. While she was getting better, she needed assistance with cooking, so I visited her every day. One day, we wrapped presents together for my cousins. She told me about her village, an old settlement by the river that was built three hundred years ago. She said there is a big gap between life then and life now. Before I left, I had to drag a heavy bag of rubbish out to the street. My teacher said my observations about Grandma's life would make a good essay, and that interaction between young and old people is good for both sides.
items.passageZh: 去年冬天，我奶奶傷了手臂，不過現在已經完全康復了。她在復原期間需要人幫忙煮飯，所以我每天都去看她。有一天，我們一起替表親們包禮物。她跟我說起她的村子，那是河邊一個三百年前建立的古老聚落。她說以前的生活和現在差距很大。離開前，我得把一大袋垃圾拖到街上。老師說，我對奶奶生活的觀察可以寫成一篇好文章，而且年輕人和年長者之間的互動對雙方都有好處。

questions.questionZh: 奶奶復原期間需要哪方面的幫忙？
奶奶的村子是什麼樣的地方？
options: 山上一座很大的度假村
海邊一個熱鬧的漁港小鎮

items.promptZh: 她很快就從感冒中恢復了。
referenceEn: She recovered from her cold quickly.
She quickly recovered from the cold.
rubricZh: recover 表示「恢復、康復」，例如 recover from a cold 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 interaction 造一個句子，說說你和別人互動的經驗或看法。
referenceEn: I enjoy the interaction with customers at my part-time job.
I like interaction with people from other countries.
rubricZh: interaction 表示「互動、交流」，例如 interaction with people 等說法
說的是自己的經驗或喜好（例如 I）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）
